title: add/list/done/history round-trip
statement: Given a fresh store, when a task is added, listed, done, and its history shown, then each command reflects the persisted state.

title: Due today is not overdue
statement: Given a task due today, when listed, then it is NOT flagged OVERDUE; a task due yesterday IS.

title: Help text is polished
statement: Given tick --help, then the text is typo-free and lists every command.

title: CSV export writes one row per task
statement: Given tasks exist in tasks.json, when `export` is run, then a CSV file with one row per task (id, title, due, done) is written beside tasks.json and the command exits 0.
